content:
jamie: Starting preflight for tenant-range migration now, holding quiet window 02:00-03:30 UTC. Preparing canary and backfill config.

sara: Confirming we pin the backend runtime to 1.12.3 and keep feature flag ‘tenant_range_v2’ off for at least 4h post-rollout?

jamie: Pinned runtime to 1.12.3 in release config (release: tenant_range_v2). FF kept OFF. Rollback criteria: p95 latency > 5s OR write error rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> abort.

matt: What's the backfill rate cap? We should avoid read-replica lag spikes during the middle of the window.

jamie: Backfill set to 150 rows/s per shard with jitter; parallelism 8. If replicas show >3s lag, drop parallelism to 2 and throttle to 50 r/s.

deploybot: Canary job queued: mig_2026_04_05_tenant_range_v2 (canary=5%). Starting canary at 2026-04-05T02:05:00Z. Logs: tail -n 50 /var/log/migrations/mig_2026_04_05.log

sara: Seeing a small read lag bump (+2s) on replica-2 but within threshold. No lock alerts yet. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Rule: alert if orphaned row-scan > 3s OR deadlocks > 1 in 10m.

jamie: If deadlocks appear, abort backfill immediately and run `deploybot set-parallelism mig_2026_04_05 2`. If deadlocks persist >10m, manual rollback.

matt: Added to release notes: "Tenant range migration: online backfill with ratecaps, staged rollout; rollback plan: pin previous schema and run stop-migration script (checkpoint id saved)."

sara: I'm on standby to execute rollback if deploybot flags an unrecoverable error. Tag me and jamie.

deploybot: Canary completed (5% traffic). No errors detected in canary metrics. Proceeding to staged rollout -> 25% at 02:25 UTC.

jamie: Staged rollout GO. Monitor token-level latency, DB locks, and write error rate. Reconvene at 02:50 for go/no-go.

matt: Checkpoint saved: checkpoint_id=8427 (for potential rollback).

sara: Ack. If anything looks off declare ABORT and tag @sara @jamie immediately.

deploybot: Staged rollout 25% complete. Backfill progress 40%. ETA to finish backfill ~00:38 from now.

jamie: RK lock metric currently 0.8% — under threshold. Continuing.

oncall-bot: Quiet window ends at 03:30 UTC (auto-lift).

deploybot: Full rollout finished at 03:12 UTC. Backfill completed successfully. Release notes draft: https://go/release/notes/tenant_range_v2

sara: Closing thread — no rollback required. Great coordination, thanks everyone :tada:
